name: All Four Together
tagline: All 4 fly PHL → Orlando Thu 5:15 AM (Frontier, booked), Magic Kingdom Thu, Epcot + parade Fri (2 hotel nights), Nicole's Sat, Southwest TPA → PHL Sun (booked) — the car waits at PHL
vibe: Re-plan after all four decided to travel together (2026-10-19). The Wednesday-night Newark JetBlue fare jumped to $851/seat for four, so the cheapest way down is Thursday morning from PHL, parking the car there for 4 days and coming home to it on the Southwest flight that uses the $500 Sapphire credit. Wednesday-night Newark options stay on the flight cards for comparison (see the ✈ Flights tab scenarios).
highlights: One car, parked at PHL Economy ($18/day) — no drop-offs or pickups
MBG parade at Epcot — Fri 10:05 AM
Two nights near the parks (Holiday Inn Resort LBV, $250 IHG credit)
Southwest home Sunday ($500 Sapphire Southwest credit)

days.label: Day 1 — Wednesday, Nov 4
days.theme: Band bus leaves · regular workday (Jaquan in New Brunswick until 5) · pack, early night

segments.activity: Thandi drops luggage at CHS band room; MBG buses depart (time TBD)
Pack carry-ons (Frontier Economy bundle = 1 carry-on + personal item each), print/load boarding passes, bed by 9:30

days.notes: No Wednesday travel: the only Wednesday-evening flights that fit a 5 PM New Brunswick finish leave Newark, and for four they now cost $2,117 (United → Tampa) to $3,402 (JetBlue → Orlando).

days.label: Day 2 — Thursday, Nov 5
days.theme: Fly PHL → Orlando 5:15 AM (booked) · Magic Kingdom 9 AM–10 PM · TRON standby at night

legs.notes: Leave home ~3:15 AM → PHL Terminal D/E garage by ~4:15 (5-min walk to Terminal E). Upper levels $32/day ≈ $128 Thu–Sun. Economy Lot ($18/day) shuttle was too tight for the 4:55 door close.
BOOKED: Frontier F9 2415 5:15 AM → 8:01 AM, $947.92 for 4. Checked in Nov 4: seats 24A (Jaquan), 25A–C; TSA PreCheck on all 4 passes.
Rideshare via the hotel to drop bags (~$35 + ~$25). No car until Saturday.

segments.activity: Leave home → PHL Terminal D/E garage (walk to Terminal E)
Frontier F9 2415 PHL → Orlando nonstop (lands 8:01 AM) — checked in, all 4 TSA PreCheck, gate E4, boarding 4:30, door closes 4:55
Rideshare MCO → Holiday Inn (~25 min); leave bags with the bell desk (check-in is 4 PM), then rideshare to Magic Kingdom (drop at the Contemporary Resort and walk ~10 min, or the TTC + monorail)
segments.notes: Carry-ons only, so no baggage claim. Ask the IHG app for an early room. Disney rideshares cannot drop at the Magic Kingdom gate.

segments.activity: Enter (park open 9 AM–10 PM). Standby rides near Tomorrowland while waiting for the first Lightning Lane
⚡ Space Mountain — Lightning Lane Multi Pass (arrive 10:50–11:50)
segments.notes: Dark and jerky — motion-sickness meds an hour before. Right after tapping in, open the app and add Big Thunder Mountain as the next Multi Pass pick.

segments.activity: Big Thunder Mountain (Multi Pass refill if available, otherwise standby) + lunch
⚡ Pirates of the Caribbean — Lightning Lane Multi Pass (arrive 2:35–3:35)
Free block — refill another Multi Pass pick (Jungle Cruise, Buzz Lightyear, Tiana's)
⚡ Haunted Mansion — Lightning Lane Multi Pass (arrive 4:25–5:25)
Dinner — Pecos Bill or Cosmic Ray's
TRON Lightcycle / Run — standby during the fireworks or the last hour before 10 PM close (Lightning Lane sold out)
segments.notes: Single Pass sold out Thu & Fri as of Nov 3 — re-check the app for cancellations (7 AM and evenings). Fast launch, no inversions.

segments.activity: Rideshare to Holiday Inn Disney Springs Area, check in (Thu & Fri nights)

days.notes: Early start (3:15 AM) bought a near-full Magic Kingdom day and saved ~$190 vs the 7:35 AM.

days.label: Day 3 — Friday, Nov 6
days.theme: EPCOT — Early Entry 8:30, parade 10:05, Guardians 7:25 PM, Luminous 9 PM

legs.notes: Hotel park shuttle (free with the resort fee) or rideshare ~10–15 min. Confirm shuttle times at the front desk Thursday night.

segments.activity: Hotel shuttle or rideshare to Epcot
Early Theme Park Entry (8:30–9:00) — Frozen Ever After / Remy standby while lines are short
Claim a parade spot near the UK pavilion (step-off)
MBG PARADE — steps off in the UK pavilion, ends at the American Adventure
Find Thandi when the band is released (~11), lunch at the Food & Wine booths
Afternoon option A: Skyliner to Hollywood Studios (~15–20 min) → Rise of the Resistance standby. Option B: bus to Animal Kingdom → Expedition Everest (needs an AK Multi Pass)
segments.notes: Rise Single Pass sold out Thu & Fri as of Nov 3 — re-check the app for cancellations. Be back at Epcot by ~7 PM.

segments.activity: ⚡ Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind — Lightning Lane Single Pass (arrive 7:25–8:25)
segments.notes: Spinning cars — the biggest motion-sickness risk. Meds an hour before, light dinner after, not before.

segments.activity: Luminous fireworks, then shuttle/rideshare to the hotel

days.notes: Lightning Lanes bought Nov 3 in the MDE app (Guardians $23pp). Park hours 9 AM–9 PM, Early Entry 8:30 for our hotel. Thandi's band is free in the park after ~11 AM.

days.label: Day 4 — Saturday, Nov 7
days.theme: Jaquan grabs the rental at MCO · drive to Nicole's by ~9:40

legs.notes: Leave ~8:10 AM after the MCO car run. Lake Buena Vista → Land O' Lakes ~95 mi, 1h30 via I-4 W.

segments.activity: MBG soundtrack workshop at Epcot (Thandi, students only) — the band stays in the parks afterward
Jaquan: rideshare alone to MCO (~20 min). Mikaela + kids pack and check out
Pick up Alamo one-way rental at MCO (Nissan Rogue or similar, $85.51 at the counter) — decline the damage waiver, pay with Sapphire
segments.notes: Confirmation in email/calendar. Pay Later, free cancellation. Returns to TPA Sun 5:00 AM.

segments.activity: Back at the hotel — load family + bags
Drive to Nicole's (~1h30)
Arrive at Nicole's — Land O' Lakes; full day together
Early dinner, gas up the rental, early night — 4:30 AM departure for the 6:15 Southwest flight

days.notes: Giving up Saturday's park day is what makes Sunday's Tampa flight work: Sunday nonstops from Orlando are $726+ per person, while Tampa has a $218 nonstop at 7:16 AM. Hollywood Studios drops out of the trip unless Thursday swaps to it.

days.label: Day 5 — Sunday, Nov 8
days.theme: Fly home TPA → PHL (Southwest 6:15 AM via St. Louis) · drive home from PHL · band buses leave tonight

legs.notes: Leave Nicole's 4:30 AM, return the Alamo rental at TPA ~5:00, at the gate well before 6:15. ~25 mi / 35 min.
BOOKED: Southwest WN 4283 TPA 6:15 AM → STL 7:40 AM CT; WN 4922 STL 10:40 AM CT → PHL 1:50 PM ET (Terminal E). Check in Sat 6:15 AM for boarding positions.

segments.activity: Leave Nicole's for TPA, return the Alamo rental by ~5:00 AM (24-hour return; refuel first)
Southwest WN 4283 TPA 6:15 AM → St. Louis 7:40 AM CT; WN 4922 STL 10:40 AM CT → PHL 1:50 PM ET — conf. in calendar (Choice, choose seats on southwest.com)
Land Terminal E, walk to the D/E garage → home by ~3:30 PM
MBG loads buses and departs Orlando for NJ (Thandi); bus reaches CHS Monday, time via Band app

days.notes: Home a day earlier than the Family Plan and Thandi is on the bus until Monday either way. If the 4:45 AM start is a dealbreaker, the 12:59 PM Atlanta connection costs $466 more for the four of us.
